identity.insurer_name: The New India Assurance Company Limited
identity.eligibility_criteria: Indian residents, lifelong renewal, no exit age once enrolled.
identity.renewal_terms: Lifelong guaranteed renewability with no loading on renewal premium based on claims history.
identity.portability_conditions: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with minimum 45 days prior notice before renewal date.
identity.geographic_availability: Pan-India (Zone I: Metro, Zone II: Tier 1, Zone III: Rest of India)

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured for room, nursing, boarding, surgeon and specialist fees.
coverage.daycare_procedures: All daycare procedures covered where 24-hour hospitalization is not required due to technological advancement.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered up to 20% of Sum Insured when treatment is taken at home due to patient condition or bed unavailability.
coverage.home_healthcare: Covered for specified treatments up to sub-limits.
coverage.ayush_treatment: Inpatient treatment covered in government recognized AYUSH hospitals up to 100% of Sum Insured.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Road ambulance covered up to 1% of Sum Insured (max ₹15,000 under UPLIFT plans).
coverage.organ_donor_expenses: Covered for harvesting expenses incurred on donor up to Sum Insured.
coverage.modern_treatments: Upto 50% of Sum Insured for robotic surgery, stem cell therapy, deep brain stimulation, oral chemotherapy.
coverage.maternity_cover: Covered under specific Uplift plan variants with 24-month waiting period.
coverage.opd_dental_vision: Covered only if necessitated by accidental injury during in-hospital care.
coverage.restoration_benefit: 100% automatic reinstatement of Sum Insured once during policy year for unrelated illness.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Cumulative bonus of 5% of base Sum Insured for each claim-free year, up to a maximum of 50%.
coverage.wellness_benefits: Free health checkup once at the end of every 3 continuous claim-free renewal years.
coverage.critical_illness_rider: Optional Critical Illness and Personal Accident rider available at additional premium.

permanent_exclusions: Weight control and bariatric surgery unless medically prescribed
Substance abuse, alcohol or drug rehabilitation
War, invasion, acts of foreign enemy, nuclear perils
Experimental, unproven, or unapproved pharmacological treatments
restrictions.room_rent_capping: 1% of Sum Insured per day for Normal Room, 2% of Sum Insured per day for ICU charges. Proportionate deduction applies if exceeded.

disease_sub_limits.Cataract: Up to ₹25,000 or 10% of Sum Insured per eye (whichever is lower)
disease_sub_limits.Hernia: Up to ₹40,000 or 25% of Sum Insured
disease_sub_limits.Joint Replacement: Up to ₹1,50,000 per joint (after 24-month waiting period)

restrictions.zone_based_restrictions: Zone I: Greater Mumbai and Delhi NCR. Zone II: State Capitals and Tier-1 cities. Zone III: Rest of India. 10-20% co-pay applies if treated in higher zone without paying zone differential premium.
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: Pre-authorization required at least 48 hours prior for planned admissions, within 24 hours for emergencies.
restrictions.medical_necessity_clause: Treatment must be medically necessary, prescribed by a qualified medical practitioner, and conform to standard medical practice.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Consumables and non-medical items (as per IRDAI list of non-payable items) are not reimbursed unless optional rider is opted.

premium.pricing_factors: Age of the eldest member, zone of residence, chosen sum insured, and tobacco use status.
premium.tenure_discounts: 5% discount on 2-year policy tenure; 7.5% discount on 3-year policy tenure.
premium.installment_options: Annual, Half-yearly, or Quarterly installment facilities available with ECS/NACH.
premium.tax_benefits: Tax rebate under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act up to ₹25,000 (individual/family) and up to ₹50,000 (senior citizens).
premium.medical_underwriting: Mandatory pre-policy medical checkup for applicants aged 50 years and above (50% cost reimbursed upon acceptance).
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 15 days free-look period less stamp duty and medical test costs. Short-period pro-rata scale thereafter.
optional_riders: Maternity and Newborn Child Extension Rider
Voluntary Co-pay Discount Option (10% or 20% discount)

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Show New India Health Card at hospital TPA desk -> TPA submits pre-auth request -> Cashless approval issued within 2 hours -> Cashless discharge finalized within 3 hours.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: Intimate within 24h of emergency or before discharge -> Submit original discharge summary, prescriptions, hospital bills, and claim form within 30 days.
required_claim_documents: Duly filled and signed Claim Form
Original Discharge Summary with detailed clinical notes
Original itemized final hospital bill and numbered receipts
Prescriptions and diagnostic reports (X-Ray, MRI, Blood Tests, Histopathology)
Pharmacy cash memos accompanied by doctor prescriptions
KYC documents and cancelled cheque of policyholder
claims.grievance_redressal_details: Grievance Cell: 1800-209-1415 / grievance.nia@newindia.co.in. Escalation to Insurance Ombudsman within 1 year if unresolved within 30 days.
claims.tpa_support: Serviced through multiple empanelled TPAs (Medi Assist, Paramount, MDIndia, Heritage Health) and In-house Health TPA.
